cases.semantics: Jsoup Element.select unions groups and returns distinct elements in source-document order, independent of group order
the same element matched by two groups is returned once

representativeSourceSet.binding: The frozen ordinal 97 rule contains .book_other:nth-child(4), .book_other:nth-child(5), exercising the same standard-pseudo selector-group consumer.

legadoSemantics.implementation: AnalyzeByJSoup delegates CSS group selection to Jsoup Element.select.
legadoSemantics.ordering: Jsoup returns the selector-group union in source-document order.
legadoSemantics.identity: distinct nodes remain distinct even when their text or outer HTML is equal

failureCondition: HTMLElement.querySelectorAll appends each selector-group result in group order and does not sort the union by document position; the reverse-group case therefore returns second before first.
